id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the SIM800L if you have multiple components.

*See also: [Sim800L Component](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#configuration-variables)*

dial.docs: Dial to a phone recipient using this action in automations.

disconnect.docs: Disconnects a call, either dialed in or received.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the SIM800L if you have multiple components.

*See also: [Sim800L Component](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#configuration-variables)*

send_sms.docs: Send a SMS message to a phone recipient using this action in automations.

send_ussd.docs: Sends a ussd code to the network.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Sim800L Component](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#configuration-variables)*

on_call_connected.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when a call is connected, either because an outgoing call accepted is accepted or an incoming call answered.

*See also: [Sim800L Component](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#configuration-variables)*

on_call_disconnected.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when a call is disconnected.

*See also: [Sim800L Component](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#configuration-variables)*

on_incoming_call.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when a call is received. See [`on_incoming_call` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#sim800l-on_incoming_call).

*See also: [Sim800L Component](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#configuration-variables)*

on_sms_received.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when an SMS is received. See [`on_sms_received` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#sim800l-on_sms_received).

*See also: [Sim800L Component](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the UART hub.

*See also: [Sim800L Component](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#configuration-variables)*

registered.docs:
Indicates if the SIM800L has successfully registered in the cellular network.

*See also: [Sim800L Component](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#configuration-variables)*

rssi.docs:
The informed Received signal strength indication (RSSI) in dBm.

*See also: [Sim800L Component](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l#configuration-variables)*
